You: The crowd went crazy. It seems to be a success.
Britannia: It wasn’t half bad for her debut. I thought she would crash and burn.
You: How about you go and tell her that?
#Britannia.face.angry
Britannia: Are you kidding me? 
#Britannia.Eyes.Closed+Britannia.Mouth.Angry
Britannia: There’s nothing more interesting to see so I’m out of here.
